Read CFG (Configuration) File

Source: R/read_cfg.R
read_cfg.Rd

This function parses SAAM/Gasel .cfg files. These files define how elementary sectors or airspaces are grouped into operational configurations (e.g., "CONF1", "Night_Config") under a specific ACC (Area Control Center) or airspace family.

The file structure is defined as follows:

  • Extension: cfg

  • Origin: Gasel, SAAM

  • Separator: Semicolon (;)

  • Sort: By family/ACC name, then by configuration name.

The file consists of:

  1. First Line: Metadata starting with # (e.g., version, dates, record count).

  2. Body Lines: Records linking an ACC/Family and Configuration to a specific Sector.

Record Structure:

  • Field 1: ACC Name (Family or Grouping ID)

  • Field 2: Configuration Name (The ID of the specific configuration)

  • Field 3: Sector Name (The component included in this configuration)

Usage

read_cfg(cfg_file)

Arguments

cfg_file

Path to the .cfg file.

Value

A data.table with the following columns:

  • acc_id: The identifier of the ACC or Airspace Family.

  • config_id: The name of the configuration.

  • sector_id: The identifier of the sector belonging to this configuration.

Details

Reads a .cfg file defining Air Traffic Control (ATC) configurations and their sector compositions.
